en: Dependent on a state that is not included [in the mundane], a state that is not included arises by way of the root condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is not included, a state that is not included arises by way of the root condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is both not included and not not included, a state that is not included arises by way of the root condition … one. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are five; in the case of the object condition, two ... pe ... in the case of the non-disappearance condition, five.
